subject.title: feat(ui): author avatar chips on user messages (incl. queued)

question: Should Control UI adopt author avatar chips for multi-user gateway messages now, with email identities intentionally limited to initials until a gateway-side same-origin avatar proxy exists?
rationale: This adds a new visible Control UI identity treatment and a persisted queue metadata surface; correctness alone cannot establish that this is the intended product direction or release scope.

options.title: Approve the bounded avatar direction
options.body: Keep the same-origin-only resolution design and merge after redacted live proof covers distinct identified users and an attributed queued send through persistence.

options.title: Defer image avatars
options.body: Keep sender labels and initials-only presentation until the gateway-side proxy and broader profile-avatar product direction are approved.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded avatar direction
recommendation.body: Keep the same-origin-only resolution design and merge after redacted live proof covers distinct identified users and an attributed queued send through persistence.

likelyOwner.reason: The related merged identity work and this proposed UI layer place steipete closest to the current end-to-end identity design.
